# Co-op target map

Every call the co-op work needs, read from the packages on this machine. Regenerate
with `python -I tools/melepkg/coop_targets.py --out <this file>`; the diff is the
change in the game's own data, not in anyone's notes.

`→` after a signature is the return type. Offsets are bytes into the parms block
the engine expects at dispatch.

**One caveat, and it matters.** A function's child exports include its *locals* as well
as its parameters, and this project has not established how the engine tells them
apart. `RemovePlayer` therefore lists `OldIndex`, which is a local. Only
`CreatePlayer` is verified end-to-end, against a live dispatch whose layout the engine
accepted - so treat its row as authoritative and any other row as "these are the
declarations, at least one may not be an argument". See `param_order` in
`mele_tables.py` for the measurement that ruled out a flag-based test.
